newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish domestic sugar quota seen at 1.63 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Polish domestic sugar quota seen at 1.63 mln T.

text.p: Poland is likely to raise its domestic sugar quota to 1.63 million tonnes in the 1997/98 growing season from 1.50 million tonnes in 1996/97, Agriculture Minister Roman Jagielniski said on Tuesday.

"For the 1997/98 growing season the government is considering allotting 1.63 million tonnes of sugar for domestic consumption and 113,400 tonnes for subsidised exports," Jagielinski told Reuters before a government meeting.
For the 1996/97 season Poland set the subsidised export quota at 122,900 tonnes.
The government was expected to set the new quota later on Tuesday at its weekly cabinet meeting.
